en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. The town is composed of dense clusters of traditional houses with pitched roofs, traversed by a winding road and a small river or stream. A prominent church with a tall spire and Gothic-style windows stands on the right side, dominating the skyline. Forested hills and fields surround the settlement. At the top center of the card, printed in red, is the caption identifying the place.
